llm.scope: Task difficulty measured by human completion time, primarily software, ML and cybersecurity work. This is neither general intelligence nor AI running time.
llm.methodology: Annual record-setting results by model release year. METR stitches Horizon 1.0 results before 2023 to Horizon 1.1 afterward. Earlier results are retrospective evaluations. Source intervals are divided by the fixed 2025 point estimate; they are not jointly estimated ratio intervals. Missing annual history is separately identified as reconstructed; it is not a METR measurement.

humanoid.scope: 14 H1 locomotion tasks, without dexterous hands; 1M environment steps; mean success-normalized return. Two selected comparable published methods; not a census of the globally best humanoid or general physical capability.
humanoid.methodology: Each task return is normalized as (return − random-policy return) / (target-success return − random-policy return), then the 14 tasks are averaged. A value of 1 denotes the success reference, not a success percentage or a mathematical maximum. Earlier task suites and training budgets are not mixed into this series.

data.metric: Published real-robot training episodes, selected corpora
data.scope: A closed inventory of reported training episodes, not all private robot interaction data, equal-duration physical experience, or a global census.
data.methodology: Fixed inventory of independently collected source families; no OXE/Octo aggregates, RoboNet components, relabeled copies, resolution variants, or simulation added. Source-level overlap audit, not hash-level deduplication. Episode lengths and segmentation differ. Alpha is replaced by Beta, adding only the difference. Initial DROID 1.0.0 is pinned; later repackaging is not new collection. RoboNet uses a later pinned TFDS representation of the 2019 corpus. Exact annual release-inventory totals are retained. Curves between annual snapshots are visual interpolation, not the actual timing of collection or release. Before 2019, the curve is an explicitly hypothetical historical reconstruction, not an inventory of these not-yet-released datasets.
